tier1.text: The tibia, or shin bone, is the main weight-bearing bone of the lower leg. Along the inner side of the leg, you can feel the tibia just under the skin. The top of the tibia meets the femur, or thigh bone, to form the knee joint. At the ankle, the bottom of the tibia meets the talus, a bone of the foot.

sentences.text: The tibia, or shin bone, is the main weight-bearing bone of the lower leg.

quotes.quote: The tibia is the main weight-bearing bone of the lower leg and the second longest bone of the body, after the femur.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

quotes.quote: tibia: shin bone; the large, weight-bearing bone located on the medial side of the leg
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: Along the inner side of the leg, you can feel the tibia just under the skin.

quotes.quote: The medial side of the tibia is located immediately under the skin, allowing it to be easily palpated down the entire length of the medial leg.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: The top of the tibia meets the femur, or thigh bone, to form the knee joint.

quotes.quote: The proximal tibia consists of the expanded medial and lateral condyles, which articulate with the medial and lateral condyles of the femur to form the knee joint.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

quotes.quote: femur: thigh bone; the single bone of the thigh
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: At the ankle, the bottom of the tibia meets the talus, a bone of the foot.

quotes.quote: Both the smooth surface on the inside of the medial malleolus and the smooth area at the distal end of the tibia articulate with the talus bone of the foot as part of the ankle joint.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.
